I                                                                                                                                                                                    Page 1 of 2 
 
Assam Schedule VII, Form No. 143 
High Court Civil Form No. (J) 13 
ORDER SHEET 
IN THE COURT OF CIVIL JUDGE (SR. DIV.), 
SEPPA, EAST KAMENG, ARUNACHAL PRADESH 
 
Title Suit No. 03/2024 & civil mis. case No. 26/2025 
Shri Thomas Nabam -Vs- Shri Jacob Tana & 15 Others 
 
Date 
Order 
Signature 
 
03.09.2025 
 
 
Plaintiff is represented by his learned counsel Mr Joram 
Mebi. 
Defendant and his learned counsel Mr Takam Sunil is 
absent, however, learned counsel Mr Darmung Lamgu represented 
as proxy counsel. 
Today this case was fixed for issues and documentations; 
however, in absence of learned counsel for the defendant, the 
case is adjourned today at the consent of learned counsel for the 
plaintiff. 
In the meantime, one misc. application being registered as 
misc. case No. 26/2025 has been filed by the applicant/plaintiff in 
the present suit against the defendants/respondents No.1 to 18 
under Order XXXIX, Rule 2A, read with section 151 of Civil 
Procedure code, 1908 claiming willful disobedience or breach of 
injunction order dated 10.06.2025 passed by this court in misc. 
case No. 09/2024. 
I have heard Mr Joram Mebi.  
Issue notice to the respondent. The petitioner shall take 
steps.  
List the case on 16.10.25 for reply by the respondent in the 
event of completion of service.  
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
(Damge Niri) 
Civil Judge (Sr. 
Dvn), Seppa
